notes.title: Will you be able to manage multiple stores at once?
notes.content:
[h2][b]Will you be able to manage multiple stores at once? And, on top of that, run an entire shopping mall? 
It’s a big challenge. 
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Did you know that as your stores and customers grow, thieves will also start to appear?[/b] [/h3]

[b][h3]That’s where the Segway Security Team comes in to help. Yes, you heard that right! We’re adding that to the game. [/h3][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092980/MALL_MANAGER_SIMULATOR/

[h2]Plus, by popular request, we’re including gift card acceptance and unique uniforms for employees in each store. And so much more! Are you excited?[/h2]

[h3]Add both games to your [h2]WISHLIST[/h2] to stay updated on everything in time.[/h3]
